title: Wastewater Stabilization Lagoon: Intermittent Sand Filter Systems
lineage: Paraphrased historical research notes on inspected passages, not a reproduction of the source.

passages.locator: March 1980 title page; historical section, printed p. 8
passages.note: Historical section p. 8 says the Lawrence Research Station in Massachusetts began studies of intermittent wastewater filtration in 1887. This retrospective also discusses earlier English practice and does not establish a global origin.
